paite: Amittai tapa Jonah kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
heading: Nineveh A Jonah Sawlna

paite: "Thou inla, Nineveh khua, khopi thupitak ah hoh inla, atungthu kikoupih in; ka ma ah agitlouhna uh ahong tungtouta," achi hi.

Himahleh Jonah bel TOUPA ma a kipan Tarshish ah taimang ding in athou a; Joppa ah ahohsuk hi. Tarshish zuan ding long amu a; huchi in atuanman pia in, TOUPA ma a kipan Tarshish zuan dingte toh ton ding in long ah alutsuk hi.
heading: Thumang Lou A Jonah Taisiatna

paite: Himahleh TOUPA'N huih hat mahmah tuipi ah anungsak a, tuipi ah huihpi hat mahmah anung hi, huchi in long tamzak ding bang in a-omta hi.
Long mite'n lau in, amau pathian chiat asam ua; long zanna ding in long sung a vante tuipi ah apaikhia uhi. Jonah bel long sunggilpen ah na lutsuk pah a, huai ah lum in, ana ihmu hithit hi.
Huchi in longheutu akiang ah ahong pai a, “Aw nang ihmu, bangchidan ahia? Thou inla, na Pathian sam in, Pathian in, i manlouhna ding in ahon ngaihtuah khamoh ding hiam,” achi hi.
“Khai, hiai thil hoih lou i tung ua hong om kua ziak ahia chih i theihna ding in, ai i san ding uh," chi in akihou uhi. Huchi in ai asan ua, aisan Jonah tung ah atuta hi.
Huchi in akiang ah, "Hiai thil hoih lou i tung ua om kua ziak ahia, hon hilh in, ka hon ngen uh; na nasep bang ahia? Koi a kipan a hong na hia? Koi gammi na hia? Bang mi na hia?" achi uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Hebru mi ka hi; tuipi leh gam bawlpa TOUPA, van Pathian ka lau ahi," achi hi.
Huchi in mite'n akihta mahmah ua, akiang ah, "Bangziak a hiai bang hih na hia?" achi ua ahilhkhitsa ahih ziak in mite'n TOUPA ma a kipan taimang ahi chih lah athei ngal ua.
Huchi in akiang ah, "Kou a dia tuipi kihot adaihna ding in na tung ah bang ka hih ding ua?" achi ua; tuipi lah akihot sang hulhul ngal a.
heading: Long A Pan Jonah Paihkhiakna

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, “Hon domkang unla, tuipi ah hon lawnkhia un; huchi in nou a ding in tuipi akihot nawn kei ding; kei ziak in na tung uah hiai huihpi thupitak anung ahi chih ka thei hi,” achi hi.
Himahleh mite'n gam a kik ding in nakpi in long akal ua; himahleh ahi thei kei; tuipi lah atung uah anak kihoh semsem ngal a.

Huaiziak in TOUPA asam ua, “Aw TOUPA, hiai | mipa hinna ziak in hon hihmang ke'nla, mihoih sisan moh ka tung uah nga mahmah lou ding in nakpitak in ka hon ngen uhi; TOUPA, hiai lah nang na deih bang a na hih ahi ngal a," achi uhi.
Huchi in Jonah adomkang ua, tuipi ah alawnkheta ua; huchi in tuipi kihot phul vonvon adaita hi.
Huchi in mite'n nakpitak in TOUPA alau ua; TOUPA kiang ah kithoihna alan ua, thu achiam uhi.
TOUPA'N Jonah valh ding in nga liantak anasep khin a; huai ngapi gilsung ah Jonah, ni thum leh zan thum a-om hi.
